title: LightPlan project
description: A persisted LightPlan project, format version 1. Lengths are feet, image points are pixels of the stored (downscaled) image with the origin at the top-left and y down, and angles are degrees. Ids are strings with a type prefix (prj_, img_, pl_, ref_, ft_, out_, cir_). null means "not set, use the default". Derived results are never stored here; exports carry them under a separate "derived" key (see #/$defs/exportFile).

version.description: Format version. Older versions are upgraded by migrateProject; newer ones are refused.

name.description: Project name shown in the app and on reports, usually the street address.

createdAt.description: When the project was created (ISO 8601), or null if unknown.

updatedAt.description: When the project was last changed (ISO 8601), or null if unknown.

images.description: Photos of the house. Pixels are stored separately under each image's storageKey.

activeImageId.description: Id of the photo shown in the editor, or null when there are no photos.

planes.description: Measurement planes: walls calibrated from a perspective rectangle and references, and roof or ground planes derived from a wall.

features.description: Traced parts of the house that get lights (rooflines, windows, bushes, trees and so on).

outlets.description: Power outlets marked on the photos.

circuits.description: Breaker circuits the outlets belong to.

point.description: Image point [x, y] in pixels of the stored image; origin top-left, y down.

tapErr.description: Optional. Expected tap error (1 sigma) of each point beside it, in pixels of the stored image, index for index. Set by the editor from the zoom at the moment of the tap. Missing, or not one number per point = no information (2.5 px is assumed).

quad.description: Four image points as tapped. Order them with geometry.orderQuad to get [TL, TR, BR, BL].

pitch.description: Roof pitch as rise over run, e.g. 6/12.

customer.description: Customer details printed on the quote.

wastePct.description: Percent added to every linear run (and to clip counts) for waste, corners and drops. Default 10.

roofPitch.description: Project default roof pitch. null = unknown: estimated from gable rakes traced on a wall, else 6/12 is assumed.

colorMode.description: Default light color for every run: warmWhite, coolWhite, multicolor or custom.

customColors.description: Colors used when colorMode is "custom" (cycled along each run).

lengthFormat.description: How lengths are shown: "ft-in" (32′ 4″) or "ft-decimal" (32.3 ft).

image.description: One photo. Pixels live in browser storage (Phase 2: object storage) under storageKey.

width.description: Width of the stored image in pixels (long side at most config.maxImageSide).

height.description: Height of the stored image in pixels.

exif.description: Camera data read from the JPEG, or null when the file had none.

storageKey.description: Key of the stored pixels (IndexedDB/localStorage in Phase 1). Exports carry the pixels as data URLs under this key.

kind.description: upload, camera (phone camera through the file picker), sample, streetview or aerial.

capturedAt.description: When the photo was taken (from EXIF), or null.

attribution.description: Credit line required by the image source, or null.

exif.description: Subset of JPEG EXIF used for the camera model.

width.description: Pixel width recorded in EXIF, when present.

height.description: Pixel height recorded in EXIF, when present.

dateTime.description: DateTimeOriginal as written by the camera, when present.

cameraSettings.description: How the focal length is chosen for this photo.

mode.description: auto (EXIF, else estimated from a wall rectangle, else phone 1x), exif, preset or manual.

presetId.description: Camera preset id (camera.CAMERA_PRESETS) used in preset mode, e.g. "phone1x".

focalPx.description: Focal length in pixels of the stored image, used in manual mode.

plane.description: A flat surface of the house used for measuring. Walls: plane coordinates [u, v] in feet, u right, v up, origin at the rectangle's bottom-left corner. Roof and ground: [a, b] feet, a along the defining line, b across it (up-slope or toward the street).

imageId.description: Photo this plane is traced on.

kind.description: wall (vertical), roof (sloped, derived from a wall eave) or ground (horizontal, derived from a wall base).

rect.description: Perspective rectangle on this wall (e.g. a garage door or the facade corners), or null.

refs.description: Calibration references (known lengths or rectangles) lying on this plane.

derived.description: For roof and ground planes: how the plane hangs off its parent wall. null for walls.

planeRect.description: A real rectangle on the wall seen in perspective. Gives the perspective correction (homography).

widthFt.description: True width in feet; null with heightFt null = size unknown (scale then comes from refs).

heightFt.description: True height in feet; null = size unknown.

tapErr.description: Optional tap error of each of the 4 corners (see #/$defs/tapErr).

planeDerived.description: Roof: line is the eave on the parent wall and the plane slopes up and away at pitch. Ground: line is the wall base and the plane is horizontal toward the camera (pitch ignored).

parentPlaneId.description: Id of the wall this plane is built from.

line.description: Two image points on the parent wall: the eave (roof) or the wall base (ground).

pitch.description: Roof pitch for this plane; null = project roofPitch, else estimated, else 6/12.

tapErr.description: Optional tap error of the 2 points of line (see #/$defs/tapErr).

ref.description: A calibration reference: a line of known length (or N siding/brick courses) or a rectangle of known size.

lengthFt.description: Line refs: true length in feet (courses refs: courses × course height).

courses.description: Line refs from a siding or brick preset: number of courses spanned; null otherwise.

widthFt.description: Rect refs: true width in feet.

heightFt.description: Rect refs: true height in feet.

quality.description: How much to trust it: high (door, garage door), medium (siding, brick), low.

tapErr.description: Optional tap error of each point: 2 numbers for a line, 4 for a rect (see #/$defs/tapErr).

feature.description: A traced part of the house that gets lights.

id.description: Feature id, e.g. "ft_1". Its light run is "run_" + id.

imageId.description: Photo the points are traced on.

planeId.description: Plane used to measure it; null = not measurable yet.

type.description: Feature type (catalog.FEATURE_TYPES). Geometry: polyline, polygon, vertical (2 points, base then top) or area.

label.description: Name shown in lists and the checklist, e.g. "Front eave".

closed.description: True when the outline loops back to its first point (windows, bushes).

overrideFt.description: Tape-measured length in feet that replaces the measured one. Polyline/polygon: length or perimeter; tree/column: height (wrap length is recomputed); bush: ignored.

productId.description: Product to use; null = the type default from the library config.

color.description: Color for this run; null = project colorMode.

tapErr.description: Optional tap error of each point, one number per point (see #/$defs/tapErr).

featureParams.description: Type-specific options. null = the type default.

mount.description: How the lights attach (sets the clip type): gutter, shingle, allInOne, ridge, adhesive, zipTie, stake or none.

diameterIn.description: Tree trunk or column diameter in inches.

spiralSpacingIn.description: Vertical gap between wraps in inches (tree, column).

wrapMode.description: Trees: trunk (spiral wrap) or canopy (planned by light count).

outletId.description: Force this run to be powered from this outlet.

reverse.description: Start the run at its last point instead of letting the planner choose.

ownCord.description: Give this run its own cord from the outlet: no jumper to or from another run. Optional; missing means false.

outlet.description: A power outlet marked on a photo.

imageId.description: Photo the outlet is marked on.

planeId.description: Plane the outlet sits on (used to measure cord length).

gfci.description: True when the outlet is GFCI protected. Unprotected outlets get a portable GFCI adapter in the BOM.

circuitId.description: Breaker circuit this outlet is on; null = unknown (assumed alone on a 15 A breaker).

receptacles.description: Number of sockets on the outlet.

circuit.description: A breaker circuit. Safe continuous limit = breakerAmps × voltage × 0.8.

breakerAmps.description: Breaker rating in amps (15 or 20 in most homes).

existingLoadW.description: Watts already used on this circuit by other things while the lights are on.

library.description: Project overrides of the product library and rules of thumb.

products.description: Full replacement product list; null = catalog defaults. Supplier products that are not in the list are added from the supplier map when the plan is computed.

config.description: Overrides deep-merged into catalog.DEFAULT_CONFIG (clip spacing, labor rates, power limits, buying and so on); null = defaults.

supplierId.description: Optional. Who the project buys from: "generic" (any store), "cle" (Christmas Lights Etc) or "1000bulbs". Missing, null or an unknown id = any store.

buying.description: How C7/C9 from the chosen supplier is bought and costed (library.config.buying). Both keys are optional.

style.description: bulk = socket wire cut to length, bulbs by the box and slide-on plugs (default); strings = ready-made strings.

costBasis.description: bought = the plan costs everything that is ordered (default); used = only the share of bulk wire, bulbs and plugs this job uses.

offer.description: One thing that can be ordered from a supplier: a bulk component (wire, a bulb colour, a plug) or an accessory.

sku.description: Price key for pricing.overrides: "<supplierId>:<supplierSku>" (a short name instead of the part number when that is not confirmed).

supplierSku.description: The part number to type at the supplier; null = not confirmed, order from the link.

price.description: Price of one pack, spool or piece in USD.

packQty.description: How many come in one pack.

priceStatus.description: verified = seen on the supplier's page that day; observed = seen in a search result, not confirmed.

notes.description: A short caution printed on the BOM line.

bulkComponents.description: The parts a bulk C7/C9 product is bought as (product.kind "bulk").

wire.description: Socket wire by the spool (an offer with the extra fields below).

spoolFt.description: Feet of wire on the spool.

wireType.description: Insulation grade of the wire; slide-on plugs must match it.

maxAmps.description: Amp rating of the wire as the supplier lists it (the lower figure when the listing gives two).

sizes.description: Other lengths of the same wire that can be bought, for jobs that do not need a whole spool.

lengthFt.description: Feet of wire in this length.

bulb.description: Screw-in bulbs by the pack, one offer per colour sold.

name.description: Name of the bulb family without a colour, used for a colour that is not on file.

wattsEach.description: Watts per bulb as the supplier lists it.

defaultVariant.description: Key in variants used for pricing a colour the supplier does not list.

variants.description: Colour key (warmWhite, coolWhite, multi, red, green, blue...) to the offer for that colour.

plugMale.description: Slide-on male plug; null = none on file (the BOM lists a plain plug line).

plugFemale.description: Slide-on female plug; null = none on file.

product.description: A light product (catalog Product). Import refuses a product without a valid category, unit, lit length, watts, end-to-end limit or price; the planner also skips products whose data it cannot use and says so.

sku.description: Price key: pricing.overrides and BOM lines use it.

stringLengthFt.description: Lit length per unit in feet.

wattsPerUnit.description: Watts per string/net/set, or per foot when unit is "foot".

maxEndToEnd.description: Most units that may be connected end to end on one feed.

coverageSqFt.description: Net lights only: area one net covers.

stakesPerSet.description: Path lights only: stakes per set.

stakeSpacingIn.description: Path lights only: inches between stakes.

dropLengthsIn.description: Icicle lights: drop lengths used by the preview.

colors.description: Color modes the product is sold in.

clipEligible.description: True when the product hangs with roofline clips.

enabled.description: False hides the product from auto-planning.

suitableFor.description: Feature types the planner may pick it for.

notes.description: Free text shown in the library editor.

supplierId.description: Supplier this product is from ("cle", "1000bulbs"); missing = any store. Supplier product ids are "<supplierId>:<name>".

supplierSku.description: The part number to type at the supplier; null = not confirmed, order from the link.

url.description: Product page at the supplier (https only).

priceStatus.description: verified = seen on the supplier's page that day; observed = seen in a search result, not confirmed.

equiv.description: Id of the generic product whose job this one does, e.g. "c9-led": the planner swaps it in when the project buys from this supplier.

kind.description: bulk = socket wire cut to length + bulbs + plugs, planned per foot (unit "foot"). Missing or null = a ready-made product.

components.description: Bulk only: the parts it is bought as (wire, bulbs, plugs).

maxRunFt.description: Bulk: longest single run in feet (default 250).

maxBulbsPerRun.description: Bulk: most bulbs on one run (default 250).

maxConnectedW.description: Most watts this product's wiring may carry end to end, its own lights plus whatever is plugged into its end. Default maxEndToEnd x wattsPerUnit.

endConnector.description: True when another run or a jumper cord can plug into its end. Default false only for unit "foot".

orderNote.description: A short caution printed on the BOM line (for example which size to pick on a page that lists several).

overrides.description: SKU → unit price in USD, replacing the library price in the BOM.

quote.description: Installer mode: settings for the customer quote.

enabled.description: True when installer mode (quote) is on.

company.description: Installer company name printed on the quote.

laborMethod.description: perFt (charge per installed foot plus hourly trees and bushes) or perHour (charge the estimated hours).

markupPct.description: Percent added to the materials cost.

takedownFee.description: Flat fee for taking the lights down after the season (USD).

storageFee.description: Flat fee for storing the lights until next season (USD).

taxPct.description: Sales tax percent applied to the marked-up materials.

notes.description: Free text printed at the bottom of the quote.

exportFile.description: JSON export wrapper written by schema.exportProject and read by schema.importProject.

images.description: storageKey → image data URL ("data:image/jpeg;base64,..."). Empty when exported without photos.

derived.description: Recomputed plan at export time, for Phase 2 consumers. Never read back on import.

derivedPlan.description: Output of plan.computePlan (loosely typed; recomputed from the project, so it is informative only).

measured.description: measure.measureProject result: cameras, plane solutions, pitch, per-feature measurements, totals, warnings.

runs.description: Light runs with products, quantities, watts, clips and power assignment.

power.description: Chains, feeds, outlets, circuits, cords, counts, totals and warnings.

bom.description: Bill of materials lines, subtotal and totals by category.

summary.description: Headline numbers: feet, strings, clips, cords, timers, watts, cost.
